title: EBU R 128 Streaming Monitor
summary: A monitor for the interim streaming range described by EBU R 128 S2.
descriptionMarkdown: EBU R 128 S2 prefers programmes to remain at −23 LUFS with accurate loudness metadata. When a broadcaster instead adapts content before streaming, S2 permits an interim Distribution Loudness Level from −20 to −16 LUFS. This Profile uses the midpoint, −18 LUFS, as its reference and warns outside that range; −18 LUFS is not presented as the only EBU streaming target. The True Peak check follows the R 128 production ceiling inherited by programmes prepared for this workflow.

references.title: EBU R 128 S2 Loudness in Streaming
references.relevanceMarkdown: Recommends unchanged −23 LUFS streaming with metadata and defines the interim −20 to −16 LUFS distribution range represented by this monitoring Profile.
